title: Micro Frontends
definition: Micro Frontends decouple a massive frontend monolith into independent deployable units. This allows independent teams to use different frameworks (React, Vue) within the same page without blocking each other's deployments.
simpleExplanation: A website where the header is built by the React team, the footer is built by the Vue team, and they are stitched together perfectly when you visit the URL.
